keywords.indexterm: automatic climate control system sunroof inside air recirculation sunroof inside air recirculation

conbody.p: The outside (fresh) air position is automatically selected, when the sunroof is opened. When you select the recirculated air position, the system maintains the recirculated air position for 3 minutes and then automatically converts to the outside (fresh) air position.
When the sunroof is closed, the air intake position will return to the original position that was selected.
